independent_object_disassembly.interpretation: The compiled body visibly reads the GET register value and keeps its low 20 pointer bits. It contains no compare/test branch corresponding to the source UVM_ASSERT on this path; assertion elision is consistent with the observed release artifact, but this does not characterize other build modes.
observed_instructions: load 32-bit GET-register pointer from parent_gpu offset 0x1090

limitations: Static analysis only; no execution on Volta or any GPU.
The Ghidra pseudocode is incomplete because of the fentry control-flow classification.
The objdump instruction interpretation is based on the compiled module and does not prove MMIO behavior, GPU register semantics, callback selection, or fault-buffer correctness.
The raw Ghidra report and disassembly are local ignored artifacts; only this path-free receipt is suitable for transfer.

rea.observed_limitation: Ghidra reports the entry call to __fentry__ as terminal (hasNoReturn=true); its pseudocode leaves the loaded GET value unresolved. The pseudocode is not used as recovered source.

source_reference.behavior: UVM_GPU_READ_ONCE of pFaultBufferGet; UVM_ASSERT that GET is below max_faults; READ_HWVALUE extracts FAULT_BUFFER_GET.PTR.
